programs.title: X: The Generation That Changed the World
programs.desc: Often called outsiders, searching for the meaning of their own existence, working from dawn to dusk, although rejecting the rat race and excessive consumerism - generationThe filmmakers will trace all the most important events that influenced the formation of representatives of this generation.Viewers will learn how the development of technology - from the pocket calculator to the birth of Google - social and political upheavals and the emergence of mass culture have changed their everyday lives.
